name: ace
description: ACE — a golf-themed provably fair crash original for real-money crypto casinos.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ace/core && npm run build -w @ace/server && npm run build -w @ace/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @ace/core && npm run build -w @ace/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p api/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:vercel: node scripts/fetch-assets.mjs && npm run build -w @ace/core && npm run build -w @ace/server && npm run build -w @ace/web
